name: MajlisAlpha UAE Pilot KPI Board
purpose: Track whether the UAE pilot is healthy enough to scale by measuring activation, source readiness, answer quality, retention, paid intent, trust friction, and roadmap focus.
kpiPolicy: Do not scale the pilot unless usage, trust, source readiness, and paid intent move together.

healthBands.meaning: Scale carefully; trust and demand are visible together.
healthBands.rule: Meets activation, answer quality, source readiness, repeat usage, and paid-intent thresholds.
Strong interest but weak repeat usage, trust, or paid intent.
Users praise the demo but do not bring real questions, sources, or payment conversations.

metrics.definition: Users who ask a real UAE market question and complete at least one answer workflow.
Questions tied to an issuer, source need, portfolio decision, or catalyst event.
Uploaded or pasted source records with official URL, issuer, period, date, and text.
Answers that pass Answer Quality Lab and Claim Trace Inspector thresholds.
Activated users who ask a second question, export a brief, or save a watchlist.
Users asking about price, access, invoice, team plan, or keeping the pilot.
Specific source, trace, or confidence objections resolved with visible workflow changes.

yellow: paid interest but weak source readiness
high praise but low repeat usage
red: users do not bring real questions
answers fail trace or quality gates
pilot feedback is mostly compliments without behavior

reviewCadence: Review KPIs every three pilot days.
Open Mission Control tasks for any yellow or red metric.
Do not add new features until trust and usage bottlenecks are explained.
Use Customer Signal Room evidence before changing pricing or roadmap.
